title.narrative: Economic Recovery Program (formerly Public Resource Management Reform Program)

description.narrative:
The Program will identify and support fiscal correction measures over the short term while developing systems and procedures to augment and diversify the revenue base and strengthen expenditure management over the medium term in order to set public finances on a sustainable path.
The Program will (i) strengthen the fiscal management institutions, (ii) enhance and diversify the revenue base of the economy, (iii) contain expenditure pressures on the budget while strengthening the functions of government, (iv) reduce government involvement in the economy, and (v) establish market-based instruments to improve treasury management.

description.narrative: Creation of greater fiscal space in the budget, and financial flexibility through a more diversified tax base and rationalized expenditure, better debt management, and more efficient privatization of SOEs as well as deepening the financial market with the issuance of Treasury bills and bonds
Progressive reduction in the number of privatized SOEs (2008 baseline: one)
Year-on-year tax revenue increase through diversification of tax (2008 baseline: $265 million) Data Source: Auditor general's annual report
Debt to GDP ratio (2008 baseline: 53.9%) Data Source: ADB review missions
Current expenditure as a share of total expenditure (2008 baseline: 79.7%) Data Source: Official gazette
Completion of projects without cost overruns/ Improved portfolio ratings (2008 baseline: frequent cost overruns)

Improved ability to link resource allocation with the medium-term fiscal policy objectives (2008 baseline: no linkage between resource allocation and MTFF policy baseline) Data Source: MOFT and MMA reports and statistics

Improved transparency and accountability of the budget process consistent with the MTFF (2008 baseline: no consistency between the budget process and MTFF) Data Source: Budget speech and budget documents (MTFF, PSIP)
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Strengthening fiscal policy and bolstering budget formulation and implementation. Indicator: Align expenditure and budget deficit with the 3-year rolling budget framework (2008 baseline: no alignment) Data Source: Official gazette

Output: 1. Strengthening fiscal policy and bolstering budget formulation and implementation. Indicator: Fiscal Responsibility Act is operational (2008 baseline: not operationalized) Data Source: Budget document including MTFF

Output: 1. Strengthening fiscal policy and bolstering budget formulation and implementation. Indicator: Fiscal deficit is reduced down to 15% of GDP in 2010 (2009 baseline: 28% of GDP) Data Source: Government circulars

Output: 1. Strengthening fiscal policy and bolstering budget formulation and implementation. Indicator: Reformulated 7th National Development Plan becomes the new Poverty Reduction Strategy, and results framework facilitates monitoring of Plan objectives and targets (2008 baseline: none) Data Source: MOFT fiscal statistics

Output: 1. Strengthening fiscal policy and bolstering budget formulation and implementation. Indicator: Strengthened cash balances projections and estimates for the year (2008 baseline: weak cash balances projects and estimates) Data Source: ADB review missions

Output: 2. Implementing Revenue, Expenditure and Debt Management Measures to Strengthen the Fiscal Policy Indicator: Approval of redundancy program and its implementation (2008 baseline: no redundancy program)

Output: 2. Implementing Revenue, Expenditure and Debt Management Measures to Strengthen the Fiscal Policy Indicator: Approval of the Government's human resource management plans (2008 baseline: no human resource management plans) Data Source: Debt strategy reports

Output: 2. Implementing Revenue, Expenditure and Debt Management Measures to Strengthen the Fiscal Policy Indicator: Finalization of Debt Strategy and publication of Debt Strategy reports (2008 baseline: no debt strategy and no relevant reports)

Output: 2. Implementing Revenue, Expenditure and Debt Management Measures to Strengthen the Fiscal Policy Indicator: GST to be implemented by 2012 (2009 baseline: no GST) Data Source: Official gazette

Output: 2. Implementing Revenue, Expenditure and Debt Management Measures to Strengthen the Fiscal Policy Indicator: Guidelines on tariff setting measures for utility services providers as a pilot (2008 baseline: no tariff setting measures)

Output: 2. Implementing Revenue, Expenditure and Debt Management Measures to Strengthen the Fiscal Policy Indicator: Maintenance of public debt at sustainable level (2008 baseline: $679 million) Data Source: ADB review missions

Output: 2. Implementing Revenue, Expenditure and Debt Management Measures to Strengthen the Fiscal Policy Indicator: Revenue augmentation through improved tax collection (2008 baseline: 47.1% as percentage of total revenue collection for the year) Data Source: Government circulars

Output: 3. Strengthening the Mechanisms for Financing the Budget Indicator: Convert all of W&MA in excess of Rf1.6 billion to Treasury bonds by end 2009. A new ceiling to be agreed between MOFT and MMA further reducing the outstanding threshold of W&MA in 2010

Output: 3. Strengthening the Mechanisms for Financing the Budget Indicator: Increasing volumes of Treasury bills are actively traded in the secondary market (2008 baseline: no Treasury bills were traded in the secondary market)

Output: 3. Strengthening the Mechanisms for Financing the Budget Indicator: Outstanding Treasury bills and operationalized open market operation (2008 baseline $56.8 million) Data Source: MAA and MOFT reports and statistics

Output: 3. Strengthening the Mechanisms for Financing the Budget Indicator: Progressively higher use of Treasury bills as a monetary instrument (2008 baseline: T-bill was not used as a monetary instrument)
Output: 3. Strengthening the Mechanisms for Financing the Budget Indicator: The W&MA ceiling is observed (2008 baseline Rf1.6 billion) Data Source: ADB review missions

Output: 4. Facilitating Privatization of SOEs Indicator: Government regulations on privatization classification, financial restructuring and redundancy program (2008 baseline: no regulations) Data Source: Official gazette
Output: 4. Facilitating Privatization of SOEs Indicator: Privatization of major SOEs (e.g. STELCO, MNSL, etc) by end 2010 (2008 baseline: one privatized SOEs) Data Source: Government circulars
Output: 4. Facilitating Privatization of SOEs Indicator: Privatization of targeted SOEs (2008 baseline: one privatized SOEs) Data Source: ADB review missions

Output: 5. Strengthening Internal Audit Operations Indicator: Implementation of internal audit manual pursuant to standard financial accounting (2008 baseline: internal audit manual does not exist) Data Source: Government circulars
Output: 5. Strengthening Internal Audit Operations Indicator: Implementing new financial regulations in line with international public sector accounting standards (2008 baseline: none exists)

Output: 5. Strengthening Internal Audit Operations Indicator: Preparation of framework for producing periodic and ad hoc internal audit reports (2008 baseline: framework does not exist) Data Source: Official gazette
Output: 5. Strengthening Internal Audit Operations Indicator: Receiving regular information technology audit reports (2008 baseline: none exists)

Output: 5. Strengthening Internal Audit Operations Indicator: Roll out the internal audit function as a model into other line ministries and agencies (2008 baseline: independent audit function does not exist) Data Source: ADB review missions
